stock.description: Shouhui Group Limited provides life and health insurance intermediary services in China. It operates through Insurance Transaction Services and Insurance Technology Services segments. The company offers insurance service solutions to policyholders and the insured online through life and health insurance transactions and service platforms. It also provides IT and software, consulting, insurance brokerage and agency services, claim adjustment, and inspection, valuation, and risk assessment of insurance. Shouhui Group Limited was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Tianjin, China.
